note: ONE anatomical cut route for every hemisphere of every subject. The five landmark fields (temporal_src, temporal_dst, temporal_corridor, temporal_extend, calcarine_extend) are the shared anatomical standard; apply with `mfa flatten --cut-recipe <this file>` (this file is the default).
slit_width_policy: recipe.slit_width is only the default/fallback (the one shared width the joint search used). The slit width is a technical parameter, not part of the route: the standard is the NARROWEST width that passes every quality gate on each hemisphere (1 boundary loop, 0 isolated vertices, 1 component, 0 flipped triangles, canonical orientation, hot_pack <= 3), chosen automatically with `--slit-width auto` (tries 1, 2, 3 in order) or fixed per hemisphere with `--slit-width lh=<a>,rh=<b>`.
